findings.issue: Lighthouse performance is 28-59 against a >=95 target. It improved from 28-52 after the bundle work, but total blocking time is still 1.9-2.9s against 200ms.

First-load JavaScript is 331KB against a 180KB budget. Clerk's own UI bundles total about 343KB, so NFR-003 is unattainable as written while @clerk/nextjs loads its UI on public pages. This is a specification defect, not an implementation defect.
AC-009 has no automated or measured coverage; the budget is asserted only in .lighthouserc.json.
LCP on / remains 41s because no Convex deployment is reachable; it is not a product signal.
CI is not configured, so the accessibility and Lighthouse gates do not run on pull requests.
